description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the performance of the CoT method across different difficulty levels—easy, medium, and hard—of a knowledge reasoning task. Each chart is labeled with its respective difficulty level and shows the distribution of outcomes across four categories: N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−, represented by distinct colors as indicated in the legend. In the "easy" category, the largest segment is N−K+ at 45.9%, followed by N+K+ at 40.6%, N−K− at 10.1%, and N+K− at 3.3%. For the "medium" category, the N+K+ segment is the largest at 44.6%, followed by N−K+ at 44.3%, N−K− at 7.2%, and N+K− at 3.9%. In the "hard" category, the N−K− segment is the largest at 36.8%, followed by N−K+ at 36.2%, N+K+ at 20.1%, and N+K− at 7.0%. All percentages are labeled directly within the respective slices of each pie chart, and the charts are arranged horizontally for comparison.
